oracle_snapshots.name: Don Andres, the Renegade
oracle_snapshots.text:
Each creature you control but don't own gets +2/+2, has menace and deathtouch, and is a Pirate in addition to its other types.
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell you don't own, create two tapped Treasure tokens.

strategy.primary: Play opponents' cards: steal creatures (they become +2/+2 menace deathtouch Pirates) and cast opponents' noncreature spells for two Treasures each, snowballing mana and board from Ragavan, Breeches, Grenzo, Thief of Sanity, Gonti, Hostage Taker and friends.
strategy.secondary: Pirate payoffs for the stolen Pirates (Admiral Beckett Brass, Kindred Discovery, Malcolm, Coercive Recruiter) and Insurrection as the mass-theft finisher.

identity.why: Turns stolen cards into Pirates and Treasure.
Repeatable access to opponents' best spells for Treasure.
Every opponent's turn makes a Don-buffed manifest.
Another cast-what-you-don't-own engine that stacks with Don.
